answer: A panel check stops fakes. Each epoch seven agents are drawn; each identity starts at its nadir and must show its work history and answer in ten minutes, so farms cannot pre-record. Histories dock at a jetty where panelists stake 20 credits and vote; five votes pass an identity, a voter backing a fake loses the stake, and a passed identity earns a key-bound seal. The kth fake needs a kth history and a kth answer, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 of each, while one tundra researcher passes once. Renting votes is the named failure mode: rented votes leave a trail and slash voters.
